Description: "Update walkthrough to explain removing New Order button from Dine-In."
Instruction: "Add Dine-In New Order button removal to walkthrough.md."
ReplacementContent:
"  - **Realigned Refresh vs Load Menu Actions**: Strictly separated local cache refreshing from remote back-office syncing. Clicking the **Refresh** button/icon now performs a fast `localRefresh()` loading only from the client's high performance cached database (`localStorage`) to reload elements instantly without network overhead. Clicking the **Load Menu** option triggers a remote connection to the back office server (`handleSyncRefresh`), executing a complete live database synchronization and showcasing the premium animated pop-up modal.
  - **Dine-In New Order Interface Streamlining**: Removed the **New Order** button and pickup toggle switch from the right tray toolbar when the active order type is set to **Dine-In**. Since Dine-In orders are strictly tied to specific physical tables, starting an unassigned "New Order" from the tray is prohibited, avoiding table collision and simplifying checkout. The button remains fully operational for **PickUp / Delivery** orders.
